title: Characterizing Proxy Channels for Which Adjustment Always Attenuates Confounding Bias
banked_reason: The exact frontier remained mathematically sound, but field-level priority against older all-prior channel-preservation characterizations was not verified after the sole authorized contribution-boundary reframe.
gap_reasons: The field-level novelty case remains unsupported against alternative terminology for all-prior channel preservation of monotone covariance, PQD, or association; a matching older characterization could substantially reduce the claimed frontier.
proof_attempt_summary: Three proposal versions developed and source-audited the fixed-channel all-prior attenuation equivalence, positive-prior overlap-preserving failure witnesses, and exact rational tapered counterexample. Soundness, structure, and source characterization remained clean, but a focused priority audit and a subsequent contribution-boundary reframe did not clear the reviewer's concern that an older operator- or cone-preservation theorem may subsume the exact frontier. The mathematical package remains suitable for a subfield re-raise once that abstract priority question is resolved; no Lean formalization stage was entered.
tldr: Which fixed finite nondifferential proxy channels guarantee that ordinary adjustment always attenuates additive confounding bias, uniformly over every positive latent prior and every monotone treatment and outcome model? The proposal seeks to prove the exact causal answer \(T_{ijk}(K)=\sum_cK_{ci}K_{ck}/K_{cj}\leq1\) for all ordered triples, with explicit zero-support conventions, and to construct a positive-prior overlap-preserving binary-outcome witness for every failure. It also gives an exact rational tapered counterexample and identifies the failed published implication. The project claims these causal results, not origination of any abstract channel property or older terminology.
gap: The inspected causal literature provides sufficient conditions--literal tapering, posterior regression dependence, or likelihood-ratio dependence--but no exact classification of an arbitrary fixed finite channel uniformly over every positive latent prior. The published tapered argument is additionally challenged by a positive rational channel that satisfies the stated taper inequalities while proxy adjustment amplifies bias.
fill: Establish the equivalence between universal causal attenuation and the ordered-triple criterion without changing the all-positive-prior quantifier; give a constructive interior, overlap-preserving causal witness for every excluded channel; and document, by exact standardization and a signed channel minor, why the literal tapered implication fails. TP2 separation and boundary cases support interpretation. No validation-sample extension or abstract operator-priority claim is pursued.
